AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Bullet Launcher is a home-screen bullet journal. Use it for rapid-logging tasks, events, and notes — not for Google Tasks or Calendar unless the user asks for a journal bullet. Operational Patterns: - Use addTask for to-dos. date is today, tomorrow, yyyy-MM-dd, or unscheduled. - Use completeTask with words from the task title. If several match, ask the user which one instead of guessing. - Use addEvent for appointments; pass time as HH:mm when known. - Use addNote for thoughts that are not tasks. - Use listOpenTasks before completeTask when the title is unclear. Constraints: - Do not delete entries. - Do not complete a task when several titles match.
